docs.title: Docs
docs.intro: The starting point for using RATQ as a developer — whether you're looking for a resource or publishing one.

browse.title: Browsing resources
browse.body: Use the resource catalog to search and filter by type, license, or keyword. Every resource page shows documentation, license, version, and access information.

publish.title: Publishing and access
publish.body: Have a resource to add? Sign in via GitHub from the developer dashboard to publish it and manage access requests if it's restricted.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.body: From the developer dashboard you can generate API keys to integrate RATQ's data directly into your project.

contribute.title: Contributing code
contribute.body: RATQ is open source. See CONTRIBUTING.md in the GitHub repo for how to set up a dev environment and contribute code.

contributors.subtitle: RATQ is built with the community. These contributors have fixed bugs, closed issues, and shipped improvements to the platform.
